name: Shechem
title: The Hivite Prince Who Violated Dinah
summary: Shechem was the son of Hamor, the Hivite prince of the city of Shechem. He is known for having raped Jacob's daughter Dinah, which led to a bloody revenge action by Dinah's brothers Simeon and Levi, who killed all the men in the city of Shechem.

keyEvents.title: Shechem Violates Dinah
keyEvents.description: Shechem, the son of Hamor the Hivite, saw Jacob's daughter Dinah, took her and lay with her by force. He then fell in love with her and wanted to marry her.

keyEvents.title: Shechem Asks for Dinah's Hand
keyEvents.description: Shechem asked his father Hamor to arrange the marriage with Dinah. Hamor went to Jacob to negotiate the marriage.

keyEvents.title: Negotiations Over the Bride Price
keyEvents.description: Shechem offered to pay any bride price and gift that Jacob's sons demanded, because he wanted Dina as his wife.

keyEvents.title: The Demand for Circumcision
keyEvents.description: Jacob's sons set the condition that all the men in the city of Shechem must be circumcised. Shechem agreed to this demand because he loved Dina.

keyEvents.title: The Circumcision of Shechem's Men
keyEvents.description: Shechem and Hamor persuaded the men of the city to be circumcised, and all the men in the city were circumcised.

keyEvents.title: Simeon and Levi's Revenge
keyEvents.description: On the third day after the circumcision, when the men were at their weakest, Simeon and Levi entered the city and killed all the men, including Shechem and his father Hamor. They took Dina with them home.
